request.description:
## **Retrieves a list of all products available in the Fake Store.**

**Base URL:** `https://fakestoreapi.com`

**Method:** GET

**Endpoint:** `/products`

---

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | No | Limits the number of products returned. Example: `?limit=5` |

---

### Response

Returns a JSON array of product objects.

**Status:** `200 OK`

#### Product Object Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | Unique identifier for the product |
| `title` | string | Name/title of the product |
| `price` | number | Price of the product in USD |
| `description` | string | Detailed description of the product |
| `category` | string | Category the product belongs to |
| `image` | string | URL of the product image |
| `rating` | object | Contains `rate` (average rating) and `count` (number of ratings) |

#### Example Response

``` json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "title": "Fjallraven - Foldsack No. 1 Backpack, Fits 15 Laptops",
    "price": 109.95,
    "description": "Your perfect pack for everyday use and walks in the forest.",
    "category": "men's clothing",
    "image": "https://fakestoreapi.com/img/81fPKd-2AYL._AC_SL1500_.jpg",
    "rating": {
      "rate": 3.9,
      "count": 120
    }
  }
]

 ```

request.description:
## Add New Product

Creates a new product in the Fake Store catalog.

**Endpoint:** `POST https://fakestoreapi.com/products`

---

### Request Body

The request body must be sent as **JSON** (`application/json`).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | No | Custom product ID (server may override this) |
| `title` | string | Yes | Name/title of the product |
| `price` | number | Yes | Price of the product in USD |
| `description` | string | No | A short description of the product |
| `category` | string | Yes | Product category (e.g. `electronics`, `clothing`) |
| `image` | string | No | URL to the product image |

**Example Request Body:**

``` json
{
  "id": 21,
  "title": "Wireless Bluetooth Headphones",
  "price": 59.99,
  "description": "Over-ear wireless headphones with noise cancellation and 20-hour battery life.",
  "category": "electronics",
  "image": "https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/I/61-ZTbzw6oL.jpg"
}

 ```

---

### Response

**Status:** `201 Created`

Returns the created product object, including the assigned `id`.

``` json
{
  "id": 21,
  "title": "Wireless Bluetooth Headphones",
  "price": 59.99,
  "description": "Over-ear wireless headphones with noise cancellation and 20-hour battery life.",
  "image": "https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/I/61-ZTbzw6oL.jpg",
  "category": "electronics"
}

 ```

---

### Notes

- This is a mock API — the product is **not actually persisted** in a real database.
    
- The `id` field in the response may reflect the value you sent, but it is not guaranteed to be unique or stored.
    
- No authentication is required for this endpoint.
    

---
